message.content: {"summary":"QA review of the Time Loop revision game-0001 against the original Benchmark instruction. The internal QA acceptance set uses 37 requirements; 90 acceptance criteria are reviewed once each. Current evidence: a passed isolated build check (build-0001) with import/ordinary launch/scenario launches, three Player capture playthroughs with runtime snapshots, and six replay comparisons (2 failed, 4 passed). Ad hoc Player harness traces exist under artifacts/player, but the game package inventory shows no demo_outputs traces and no packaged delivery replay. The recorded runtime state exposes substantive gameplay gaps (ghost count exceeds the per-level maximum, no fall recovery, exit-crystal gating unexercised, level geometry identical across chapters) and mock-only art. Ship readiness is not demonstrated; recommendation is not ready.","instruction_audit":"Instruction coverage is uneven. Present: Godot 4 project at /workspace/game, title screen, jump and menu text, 4 chapters of 6 levels grouped, 24 level count, build command, scenario parsing from OS.get_cmdline_user_args, demo duration cap and supported events in the trace format, and the 'up to four loops' interpretation as three recorded ghosts plus current loop. Missing or contradicted in the game package: (1) demo_outputs trace files are absent from the delivered game inventory, so the 1-10 trace deliverable is unmet at the package level; (2) visible overlapping clock hands and ghost silhouettes are asserted by node presence but not established; (3) ghost visual translucency cannot be confirmed (modulate alpha is not observed in snapshots, and ghost rendering remains mock); (4) the actual loop geometry provides no fall/death recovery and no exit gating exercise; (5) asset sourcing from the mounted Kenney/OGA libraries is not done, using mock image-service placeholders instead.
